Score and rank candidate paths, auto-selecting the best

Source: R/scaffold_scoring.R
score_candidates.Rd

Score and rank candidate paths, auto-selecting the best

Usage

score_candidates(
  candidates,
  sample_lineage = NA_character_,
  sample_taxids = NA_character_,
  expected_length = c(4000, 12000),
  weights = DEFAULT_SCORE_WEIGHTS
)

Arguments

candidates

data.frame, one row per candidate path, with columns: path, depth (mean graph depth), blast_pident (0-100), blast_lineage (rank-aligned lineage of the top hit), anchors (comma list of distinct anchors found among 18S/5.8S/28S), length (total bp), and optionally blast_lineage_taxids.

sample_lineage

The sample's resolved rank-aligned lineage.

sample_taxids

The sample's rank-aligned lineage taxids. When both this and candidates$blast_lineage_taxids are present the taxonomy term is scored on taxids instead of names.

expected_length

Numeric length-2 c(min, max) plausible rDNA repeat unit length for the clade (default c(4000, 12000)).

weights

Named weights (see DEFAULT_SCORE_WEIGHTS).

Value

candidates with added sub-score columns (s_tax, s_identity, s_anchors, s_depth, s_length), a score, a rank (1 = best), and an auto_select logical flagging the top candidate.
